description.value: Against a target already suffering an affliction, disease, poison, or curse: Critical Success it sloughs off entirely, and the target is immune to Second Opinion cast by you for 24 hours. Success the affliction's DC becomes your class DC for the rest of its duration. Failure as success, and you choose whether its next stage advances or resets. Critical Failure as failure, and it advances one stage immediately. Cast against a target carrying nothing to seize, it instead functions as The First Symptom — a Plaguewright optimizes the payload; you just sign your name over theirs.
